headline: Public hearing on FY2027 tax classification and residential factor, plus $2.5 million tax levy reduction.
summary: Community Preservation Act funds are also on the agenda, including a $4,550,000 surcharge allocation. The residential exemption percentage and residential factor set how much of the tax levy each property class pays.
items: Community Preservation Act FY2027 surcharge allocation, $4,550,000

## Special Meeting of the Waltham City Council

Public Hearing

City Hall Council Chamber

November 23, 2026

6:30pm

To the Members of the City Council and all other interested parties:

The purpose of the meeting is relative to the classification and the residential factor which shall be used by the Board of Assessors to determine the percentage of the tax levy to be borne by each class of the real estate and personal property tax for the fiscal year 2027.

## AGENDA ITEMS

- Community Preservation Act - FY2027 Surcharge allocation - $4,550,000
- Community Preservation Act - FY2026 State match allocation - $740,557
- Community Preservation Act - FY2026 Unallocated reserve allocation - $666,120.63
- Appropriation from Unreserved Fund Balance - $2,500,000
- FY2027 Residential Exemption Percentage
- FY2027 Residential Factor

No other matters will be discussed

## City of Waltham

*Jeannette A. McCarthy, Mayor*

November 19, 2026

TO: The City Council

RE: Tax Levy Reduction

Dear Councillors:

I respectfully request an appropriation in the amount of $2,500,000 from Unreserved Fund Balance to be added to the General Fund Revenue of FY2027 for the purpose of reducing the FY2027 property tax levy.

Since the School Department did not address the FY2026 deficit of $1,022,492 prior to June 30, 2026, the Department of Revenue requires the amount of the deficit be added to the FY2027 tax levy amount. To provide some relief to the taxpayers, the deficit amount is included in my total FY2027 tax levy reduction request of $2,500,000.

Also, attached are revised exhibits to the Assessors' packet to reflect the impact of my request for the $2,500,000 tax levy reduction amount.

Since this financial transaction pertains to the tax rate setting for FY2027, I respectfully request this matter be acted on during the special meeting of the City Council scheduled for Monday, November 23, 2026.

Sincerely yours,

Jeannette A. McCarthy (handwritten signature)
